name: @togetherweown/paperclip-plugin-pr-doer-wake
description: Wakes the Paperclip card that owns a GitHub pull request exactly once per (PR, head SHA, state) when its Paperclip Review lands below threshold, a check really fails, a merge conflict appears or it merges. Uses ctx.issues.requestWakeup, so blockers, terminal status and budgets are honoured by the host.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
